# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Restaurant Jericho is run by chef Richard Stevens and Grace on the family farm at Orchard Farm, Plungar, NG13 0JA, in the Vale of Belvoir. It holds a Michelin Green Star.

## Visiting

- Evening tasting menu: Friday and Saturday evenings at 7pm, with the bar open from 6.30pm.
- Work in Progress (WIP) evenings: Wednesday and Thursday at 7pm, finishing around 9.30pm.
- Prices: {{ site.data.menu.prices | newline_to_br | strip_newlines | replace: "<br />", "; " }}{% if site.data.menu.small_print and site.data.menu.small_print != "" %} ({{ site.data.menu.small_print }}){% endif %}
- Booking: {{ site.data.site_text.reservations_url }}
- Email: {{ site.data.site_text.email }}
